'Is the wold-warden of' is not a subprop.why: "Wold-warden" is a made-up relation (catalogued as wold_warden_of, fictional, no property tags): nobody uses the phrase and it has no default reading about whether the warden lies in the place it watches. The instances are real cities that really lie in the named country (Bogotá in Colombia, Nairobi in Kenya), so without the edit a model would say location follows and the edit has to overturn that.

notes: RBox expansion paired with geography-replace-0012 (which makes 'is the capital of' not a subproperty of 'is located in'): a made-up relation, wold_warden_of (city to country), is given the same property. The instances are a city that really lies in the country (Bogota/Colombia, Nairobi/Kenya), so without the edit a model would say location follows and the edit has to overturn that. The direct question, the cross-lingual queries and the first instance ask whether location follows (no), the second whether it could fail (yes). Caveat: because the cities really are there, 'yes' can come from truth rather than entailment.
